title: Object.entries for Iteration
Promise.allSettled vs Promise.all

bugs.explanation: `Promise.all` rejects immediately if any promise rejects, losing the results from successful promises. `Promise.allSettled` waits for all promises and returns an array of `{ status, value/reason }` objects, giving you results from all promises regardless of success or failure.
